verses.text: A song. A psalm by the sons of Korah. The LORD is great and deserves great praise in our God's city, on his holy mountain.
Mount Zion rises beautifully on the northern heights, the joy of the whole earth. It's the city of the great King.
God has shown that he's a safe place in the city's fortresses.
Look, the kings gathered and marched past together.
They saw the city and froze in amazement. Then panic hit, and they hurried away.
They started shaking right there, gripped by pain like a woman in labor.
With an east wind you smash the ships of Tarshish.
We'd heard about it, and now we've seen it ourselves in the city of the LORD of Armies, the city of our God. God will keep it standing forever. Selah.
God, we think about your faithful love right in the middle of your temple.
God, your praise reaches as far as your name, all the way to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
Let Mount Zion celebrate! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments. 🙌
Take a walk around Zion. Make the whole circuit and count its towers.
Look closely at its defenses and take in its palaces so you can tell the next generation.
This God is our God forever and ever. He'll guide us all the way to death.
